data.body:
[P2] Include envelope escaping in the size safeguard

The default budget stays below 1 MB, but supported constructor overrides remain unsafe. With `new LambdaLogExporter(1_000_000)`, input containing 300,000 backslashes produces roughly 600 KB of rendered JSON and passes truncation; this second serialization expands it to roughly 1.2 MB. A record that previously fit now exceeds the documented single-event limit, jeopardizing ingestion. Measure the escaped envelope during truncation, or enforce a separate final-line cap, and add a stdout-size regression test using a nondefault budget.
